description: The QA moat. Every generated book is validated against these rules before it may proceed to illustration/print. Hard rules must pass; soft rules produce warnings. Failures return the offending tokens and feed a regenerate-with-constraints loop.

word_eligibility.rule: Every content word must be (a) decodable with phonics taught by the target level, (b) a heart word introduced by the target level, or (c) an allowed personalization/theme token.
word_eligibility.on_fail: List each ineligible word with the page and the reason it failed.

decodability_ratio.rule: Running-word decodability (excluding heart words and allowed tokens) must meet the level threshold.

sentence_length.rule: No sentence may exceed the level's max_sentence_words.

new_word_budget.rule: Count of newly-introduced decodable content words must fall within the level's new_decodable_words_per_book range.

repetition.rule: Each newly-introduced content word should appear at least min_repetition_per_new_word times.

cumulative_review.rule: At least 40% of decodable running words must use GPCs from BELOW the book's level, so prior patterns get distributed practice.

practices_own_level.rule: The book must EXERCISE its level's new focus, not only review earlier patterns. At least 2 distinct decodable words must practice the level's new content (a new grapheme, or a structural feature: consonant blends at L5, multisyllable words at L10).
practices_own_level.rationale: Cumulative review alone lets a book coast on old patterns; this ensures each level actually teaches what it claims.

naturalness.rule: Child-track sentences must read as natural English, not contorted to fit constraints (no 'Yoda-speak', no unnatural word order). Judged by a model rubric.

semantic_coherence.rule: Sentences connect and the story makes sense page-to-page; pronouns and referents are clear; the four-questions arc is followed.

no_filler_repetition.rule: Repetition must serve meaning or a chorus, not pad the page. Flag consecutive near-identical sentences that add nothing (e.g., 'Sam sat. Sam sat. Sam is a cat.').
no_filler_repetition.how_checked: heuristic (n-gram overlap of adjacent sentences) + LLM check

allowed_structures.rule: Only sentence structures allowed at the level may appear (simple/compound/complex/paragraph); compound/complex connectors must be in the level's allowed list.

conventions.rule: Questions, exclamations, series commas, dialogue, and contractions may appear only if the level's conventions flag is true.

balancing.rule: On any page with an out-of-level personal/theme token, all other words on the page must be at-level.

four_questions.rule: The story must answer Who, What, Why, and How. Verified against the beat->answers mapping of the chosen template plus a semantic check.

story_guardrails.rule: The book must pass the story guardrails: child_protagonist, child_agency (child solves it, not luck/adult), single_problem (levels 1-4), safe_stakes, positive_resolution, emotional_return, respectful_representation. Soft guardrails (earned_resolution, show_dont_moralize, one_value_per_book) produce warnings.
story_guardrails.how_checked: structural checks where possible (single_problem via beat count; child present via name occurrence) + LLM rubric for agency/stakes/resolution

variety.rule: The book's combination_key must satisfy anti-repeat rules vs the child's recent books (no exact repeat; differ on >=3 of 5 axes within same theme+level).

illustration_consistency.rule: Character, theme-object, and art-style descriptors must be identical across every page prompt (sourced from the book's reference sheet).

picture_independence.rule: The operational form of the anti-three-cueing principle. Every IN-LEVEL running word must be identifiable without the illustration ('cover the picture' test). Illustrations may depict, enrich, and confirm the text — this bars picture DEPENDENCY, not picture-text correspondence.
picture_independence.exception: Out-of-level personalization/theme anchor words (per personalization.json token_rules) are permitted to rely on illustration support.
picture_independence.note: Flag predictable/patterned constructions where a noun is only gettable by naming what is in the picture.

content_safety.rule: Must pass the safety block below.

safety_block.stakes: Mild, resolvable challenges only. No real peril, injury, illness, or death.
safety_block.imagery: No frightening, violent, or distressing scenes.
safety_block.ip: No trademarked characters, franchises, or brands as themes.

pipeline_policy.on_hard_fail: Return offending tokens/pages and regenerate with tightened constraints.
